newsitem.title: UK: BOC shares ease after NatWest comments.
newsitem.headline: BOC shares ease after NatWest comments.

text.p: Shares in gases to chemicals group BOC Group Plc fell 21 pence to 1,011-1/2 pence following bearish comments from NatWest Markets, market sources said.
In a note on the shares, NatWest said BOC was due for a technical retreat after a sharp rise in the past two months, the sources said.
BOC has been in a strong uptrend since January 10 when they closed at 858 pence. The shares gained extra momentum after BOC on February 20 reported a two percent rise in first-quarter pre-tax profit.
